amount_including_tax.description: Line value incl. tax. Raw `amountIncludingVat`. Tenant-specific: the R3 file is explicit that verified tax content rules attach to the invoice, not the order line (`payroll-and-invoicing.md:563-568`), and the tax rate/jurisdiction/rounding basis needed to reconcile it is not on this record (`:545-552`).

cost_code.description: The job task / cost code the line is coded to. Raw `jobTaskNumber`.

cost_dimension_1.description: Tenant dimension code 1. Raw `shortcutDimension1Code`. Tenant-specific: BC dimension semantics are configured per tenant, and the shelf's portable cost axis is `cost_code`.

cost_dimension_2.description: Tenant dimension code 2. Raw `shortcutDimension2Code`. Same reason.

currency.description: Denomination of `amount` and `unit_cost`. Raw `currencyCode`, falling back to company base currency when the field is empty.

description.description: Line description. Raw `description`. Optional: no lens mandates it, but names it as what makes this shelf richer than `cost_element`.

document_number.description: Purchase document identity. Raw `documentNumber`. Half of the composite external id; without it no line can be deduplicated or superseded.

document_type.description: Which purchase-document kind the line belongs to (order / invoice / credit memo). Raw `documentType`. Mandatory because the bound endpoint is not type-filtered while the sibling commitments query is, so without this field an invoice line is indistinguishable from a PO line.

financial_period.description: The period the commitment is attributed to. Derived from `orderDate` by the period resolver, not a raw field.

item_reference.description: The vendor's or tenant's item identifier. Raw `itemReferenceNumber` / `vendorItemNumber`.

legal_entity.description: The company/legal entity that placed the order; supplied by company context rather than a per-row field.

line_number.description: Line identity within the document. Raw `lineNumber`. Second half of the composite id.

order_date.description: When the line was ordered. Raw `orderDate`; already the producer's `occurred_at_field`, so no new source is needed — this row records it in the payload too.

project.description: The job the line commits cost against. Raw `jobNumber`; the bound filter already excludes rows without one (`jobNumber ne ''`, `baseline_squash_02_seed.sql:1198`).

quantity.x-demiton-unit: `dimensionless` (unit of measure is a separate attribute)

receipt_expected_on.description: Expected / promised / requested receipt date. Raw `expectedReceiptDate`, `promisedReceiptDate`, `requestedReceiptDate`. Optional: no lens requires a commitment to carry a delivery date, and the three raw fields disagree in meaning.

received_complete.description: Whether the line is fully received. Raw `completelyReceived` / `finished`. Tenant-specific because "received" is a workflow state of the tenant's procurement process, not a fact about the commitment.

tax_area_code.description: Tenant tax area coding. Raw `taxAreaCode`. Same reason.

tax_group_code.description: Tenant tax group coding. Raw `taxGroupCode`. Same reason as `amount_including_tax`: tenant configuration vocabulary, no jurisdictional mandate on the order line.

unit_of_measure.description: The unit `quantity` is counted in. Raw `unitOfMeasureCode`. `quantity` is declared `dimensionless`, so the unit has to be carried as an attribute or the quantity is uninterpretable. Which of `unitOfMeasureCode` / `unitOfMeasure` is canonical is **unverified**; both are in the corpus.

vendor.description: The supplier the line is placed with. Raw `buyFromVendorNumber`. Optional because the declaration says so and the axis name is not portable.
